const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboPaint limited-mode trajectory for copying 天.
+
+Run from /app with rcb_client installed. The service records each submitted
+chunk as the episode trajectory; this file also documents the geometric
+mapping and the practice-sheet calibration used to choose the brush pressure.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0])  # brush axis vertical, pointing down
+PAPER_Z = 0.020
+PX_M = 0.227185 / 1024.0
+
+
+def paper_xy(u: float, v: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
+    """Target pixel centre -> world x,y on the main sheet."""
+    # Pixel columns run from robot-left (+y) to robot-right (-y), and rows
+    # run from the far edge (+x) toward the robot (-x).
+    return 0.0135925 - (v + 0.5) * PX_M, 0.1135925 - (u + 0.5) * PX_M
+
+
+def dense(points: list[tuple[float, float, float]], start: np.ndarray,
+          spacing: float = 0.008) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Interpolate XYZ control points so no target step exceeds 8 mm."""
+    out = []
+    prev = np.asarray(start[:3], dtype=float)
+    for point in points:
+        dst = np.asarray(point, dtype=float)
+        n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(dst - prev) / spacing)))
+        for k in range(1, n + 1):
+            p = prev + (dst - prev) * (k / n)
+            out.append(np.r_[p, DOWN])
+        prev = dst
+    return np.asarray(out, dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def follow(r: Robot, points: list[tuple[float, float, float]], note: str,
+           spacing: float = 0.008, cameras=None):
+    pose = np.asarray(r.status().get("proprio", {}).get("now", []), dtype=float)
+    if len(pose) < 14:
+        obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
+        pose = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    start = pose[7:14]
+    actions = dense(points, start, spacing)
+    last = None
+    for offset in range(0, len(actions), 180):
+        last = r.submit("ee_pose", actions[offset:offset + 180], dt=0.05,
+                        video="none", cameras=cameras, note=note)
+    return last
+
+
+def hold(r: Robot, xyz: tuple[float, float, float], n: int, note: str,
+         cameras=None):
+    obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    q = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], dtype=float)
+    target = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), DOWN]
+    # The measured TCP can lag its final target slightly; a short transition
+    # to the same location followed by repeated rows lets the PD drive settle.
+    pts = dense([tuple(target[:3])], q, spacing=0.008)
+    if len(pts):
+        r.submit("ee_pose", pts, dt=0.05, video="none", cameras=cameras, note=note)
+    return r.submit("ee_pose", np.tile(target, (n, 1)), dt=0.05,
+                    video="none", cameras=cameras, note=note + " settle")
+
+
+def main():
+    r = Robot()
+    obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    print("episode", {k: obs.meta.get(k) for k in ("time_left_s", "sim_time_s", "control_steps")})
+
+    # Lift clear of the initial staging pose, then settle at a safe travel height.
+    if now[9] < 0.345:
+        follow(r, [(now[7], now[8], 0.35)], "initial safe lift")
+    hold(r, (now[7], now[8], 0.35), 5, "settle above board")
+
+    # Ink-stone centre measured from the calibrated scene camera.
+    ink_xy = (-0.098, 0.149)
+    follow(r, [(ink_xy[0], ink_xy[1], 0.105)], "approach ink well")
+    follow(r, [(ink_xy[0], ink_xy[1], 0.022)], "dip brush below ink surface", spacing=0.003)
+    hold(r, (ink_xy[0], ink_xy[1], 0.022), 8, "load ink")
+    follow(r, [(ink_xy[0], ink_xy[1], 0.105)], "lift inked brush", spacing=0.004)
+
+    # Three short horizontal pressure samples on the unscored practice sheet.
+    # Practice centre is (-0.100, -0.1856); each line is a distinct contact.
+    tests = [(-0.045, 0.018), (-0.095, 0.012), (-0.145, 0.006)]
+    for i, (x, z) in enumerate(tests, 1):
+        y0, y1 = -0.222, -0.149
+        follow(r, [(x, y0, 0.105)], f"practice {i} travel")
+        follow(r, [(x, y0, z)], f"practice {i} press", spacing=0.003)
+        hold(r, (x, y0, z), 5, f"practice {i} settle")
+        follow(r, [(x, y1, z)], f"practice {i} pressure line", spacing=0.004)
+        follow(r, [(x, y1, 0.105)], f"practice {i} lift", spacing=0.003)
+    practice = r.get_obs(cameras=["practice_cam", "scene_cam", "side_cam"],
+                         depth=True, video="none")
+    practice.save("/app/runs/practice_calibration")
+    print("practice", {k: practice.meta.get(k) for k in ("time_left_s", "sim_time_s", "control_steps")})
+
+    # Main-sheet paths are appended after inspecting practice_calibration.
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

steps.text: The fourth pressure sample reaches roughly a 19 mm mark at a 19 mm press. I’ll keep the top and central strokes around a 5–8 mm press, shape the left descender more lightly, and build pressure along the right descender toward its broad terminal. Stroke two will join the top connector and crossbar in one contact so the main sheet stays within the four-stroke limit.
